calque.description: Convert PDFs and scans into Word documents in your browser, without sending your files to a server. Choose between preserving the look of each page and extracting editable text.
calque.alt: Illustration: a PDF page becomes a Word document, connected by an arrow.
calque.caption: From the source document to text you can work with.

coachos.description: Draw plays, organise player movements, and present them through animation. A space to develop an idea on the court and share it with the team.
coachos.alt: Illustrative basketball diagram: three numbered players, movements and a pass on a court.
coachos.caption: Concept illustration · a play brought into motion.

eclipse.description: Explore a fantasy world, fight, and solve puzzles as an expedition unfolds. A first browser-based adventure, set in a world that is still taking shape.
eclipse.alt: Mood illustration: a traveller follows a path towards an ancient gateway beneath an eclipse.
eclipse.caption: An interpretation of the world · illustration, not a game screenshot.
